title: H7: Parent-cycle vulnerability - property-level CloudKit merge can create X.parent=Y, Y.parent=X

description: Every ancestor/descendant walk EXCEPT CascadeReaper lacks a cycle guard, risking a main-thread hang or stack overflow - and wouldCreateCycle itself spins on a cycle rather than detecting it (Validators.swift:8-17, applySoftDelete, deepCopy, breadcrumb recording). Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 1, plan 1a trash-tree-integrity. Sweep: stores/persistence.
